why: OpenAI's November 17 launch of GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol updates both its flagship frontier model and its everyday model across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API, while cutting Astra's standard token prices by 20%. It affects a broad audience of developers and enterprise users, has a full primary announcement on OpenAI's site, and drew immediate independent coverage and benchmark testing.

set_aside.why: Palo Alto Networks' $4.5 billion all-stock deal to acquire Applied Compute is a notable enterprise M&A story, but narrower in immediate developer impact than OpenAI's dual model launch.
Portland Council President Jamie Dunphy's proposed municipal AI procurement moratorium is an early local ordinance draft still awaiting a council hearing and vote.
